subject: SEM with latent variable of just-identified measurement model

messages.author: 4c0a0560ca333c9c
messages.subject: SEM with latent variable of just-identified measurement model
parts:
Hi all,

I am new to SEM. Really want to thank the developer of Lavaan.
I have a question below. Hope someone would not mind clarifying my concepts.

I am doing an SEM with multiple latent variables. One of the latent variable is a just-identified model, with only 3 items (3 covariance and 3 variances), while the freely estimated model parameters were 6, zero degrees of freedom resulted. In this case, no model fit could be assessed.

May I ask if including it in the structural model, would it affect the fit or results of path analysis?
Thank you in advance for answering.

With many thanks,
Alan
